fields.description: When unchecked, the Slack webhook ignores inbound events and outbound posts are skipped.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Fallback agent that answers Slack messages (a project channel overrides this via routing).
fields.label: Default Agent Profile

fields.description: The Slack user id of the bot (e.g. U01ABCDEF). Used to skip the bot's own messages and to detect @mentions in channels.
fields.label: Bot User ID

fields.description: Slack bot OAuth token (xoxb-...). Stored encrypted.
fields.label: Bot Token

fields.description: Slack app signing secret — used to verify the X-Slack-Signature on every inbound webhook. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: Signing Secret
